# Synthetic: typed input reaching cooked and raw reads, Ctrl+C and Ctrl+Break.
packet 1 4242 0 1340 24 
expect reply 00000000 24 010000000000000002000000000000000300000000000000 0 -
# Typing before anyone reads queues records and raises the input event.
input 6869
expect input-available true
# A cooked read takes the queued text, then waits for Enter.
packet 7 1 2 28 92 0500000114000000010000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000
expect input-available false
expect vt 6869
input 0d
expect complete 00000000 8 0100000000000000000000000000000008000000 20 680069000d000a00
expect input-available true
expect vt 0d0a
# Ctrl+C ends a waiting cooked read with STATUS_ALERTED and signals the client.
packet 7 1 2 28 92 0500000114000000010000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000
expect input-available false
input 03
expect ctrl 4242 C
expect complete 00000101 0 0100000000000000000000000000000000000000 0 -
expect input-available true
# GenerateConsoleCtrlEvent(CTRL_BREAK_EVENT, 0) goes to every client.
packet 7 1 2 16 8 01000002080000000100000000000000
expect ctrl 4242 Break
expect reply 00000000 0 0100000000000000 0 -
# Without LINE_INPUT a read returns what is there; with nothing it waits.
packet 7 1 2 12 4 0200000104000000f0010000
expect reply 00000000 0 f0010000 0 -
packet 7 1 2 28 92 0500000114000000010000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000
expect input-available false
input 78
expect complete 00000000 2 0100000000000000000000000000000002000000 20 7800
# Back to cooked: an ESC where the engine cut a write is not the Escape key.
packet 7 1 2 12 4 0200000104000000f7010000
expect reply 00000000 0 f7010000 0 -
packet 7 1 2 28 92 0500000114000000010000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000
input 6162
expect vt 6162
input-more 1b
input 5b410d
expect complete 00000000 8 0100000000000000000000000000000008000000 20 610062000d000a00
expect input-available true
expect vt 0d0a
packet 2 1 0 0 0 -
expect reply 00000000 0 - 0 -
expect input-available false
expect close
expect eof
